table.brief: 地铁各线路首末班车时刻：行标题为线路名，列为“工作日首班/工作日末班/周末首班/周末末班”，全是 HH:MM

understanding.purpose: 帮助乘客查找各条地铁线路在工作日和周末的首末班车时间。
understanding.reading: 先按线路定位行，再横向读取对应日期和首末班时间；也可纵向比较不同线路的时间。表头可用两行显示，数据行保持单行以便扫描。
groups: 工作日首班与工作日末班构成一组，分别表示工作日运营的开始和结束。
周末首班与周末末班构成一组，与工作日两列对应，便于比较。
四个时间列承担相同的信息角色，应保持足够宽度以完整显示时间。
keep_intact: 线路名称，包括10号线、13号线和机场线
may_wrap: 工作日首班、工作日末班、周末首班和周末末班表头可按中文自然换行；换行由表头行高度统一吸收。

preferred.name: r0B
preferred.note: 为文字较长的工作日表头多分配空间，并保持每个日期组内首末班列等宽。

acceptable.name: r0A
acceptable.note: 四个时间列近乎等宽，突出它们的同等地位，同时完整容纳所有线路名和时间。

bad.name: r0C
bad.note: 让工作日表头占用两行，以较宽的周末列突出周末查询，同时保持四个时间值完整。
bad.why: The weekday headers break across three lines, separating 工作日 and 首班／末班 in awkward places. The extra header height and much wider weekend columns weaken the balance between columns that serve the same role.

rationale: r0B gives each weekday header enough room to keep 工作日 together, while both weekend headers break cleanly after 周末. The first and last train columns have matching widths within each day type, making comparisons easy. The line names and all times remain intact, and the data rows have a consistent rhythm. r0A is still readable, but its weekend headers leave 班 alone on the second line.

general: Give related columns a consistent treatment, while allowing widths to reflect differences in their labels.
Prefer header breaks that preserve meaningful words and phrases, and keep identifiers and values intact.
specific: The longer 工作日 labels benefit from more width than the 周末 labels.
A 69px line-name column accommodates the longest route labels without wrapping.

tradeoffs: r0A gives the four time columns more nearly equal widths, which some designers may value for comparing times across the table; r0B uses that space to make the header phrases easier to read.
uncertain: The ranges are conservative visual estimates around r0B, not browser-tested thresholds. They are coupled: adjust the other columns proportionally and keep the total at or below 359px, rather than applying all upper bounds at once.

critique.good: 线路名称和时间均保持完整，数据行等高，横向查找和纵向比较都很顺畅。两组时间列宽度接近，整体均衡。
critique.problems: 周末表头断成“周末首／班”和“周末末／班”，把“首班”“末班”拆开，削弱了表头的语义和节奏。
critique.cause: 周末两列各73px，扣除内边距和边框后可容纳三个汉字，第四字被挤到下一行。

critique.good: 表头按“工作日／首班”“工作日／末班”及“周末／首班”“周末／末班”分行，日期与首末班的对应关系清楚。所有线路名称和时间完整，数据行紧凑且容易扫描。
critique.problems: 工作日列比周末列略宽，但这一差异与表头文字长度相符，没有明显妨碍比较。
critique.cause: 工作日列各80px，容纳“工作日”；周末列各65px，使“周末”和“首班”或“末班”分别成行。线路列69px足以容纳最长名称。

critique.good: 线路名称和所有时间完整，数据行保持单行；周末两列留有充足空间。
critique.problems: 工作日表头被拆成三行，连“工作日”和“首班”“末班”都被拆散，增加表头高度并干扰辨认。周末列明显更宽，四个同类时间列的比例失衡。
critique.cause: 工作日两列各63px，扣除21px后仅剩42px文本宽度；周末两列各82px，占用了工作日表头需要的空间。

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

r0B.why: 线路名称和时刻均保持完整；表头按工作日、周末及首末班自然分成两行，各对列宽一致，便于比较。

r0A.why: 线路名称和时刻完整，行距紧凑；但周末表头将“班”单独折到第二行，层次不如按词组断行清晰。

r0C.why: 工作日表头被拆成三行，周末表头也将“班”单独留在第二行；各时刻列宽差异较大，削弱了并列关系。

ref_auto.why: 线路列过窄，每个线路名称都被拆行，显著增加行高并妨碍按线路扫描；周末表头也断在“班”之前。

ref_equal.why: 线路名称和时刻完整，行与列易于扫描；但周末表头将“班”单独折行，两组时刻列的宽度也略有差异。

raw.unsure: B 和 E 的差别较小；两者主要问题都是周末表头的断行。

ref_auto.why: Every line name wraps, making the rows tall and breaking the identifiers, although the times remain intact.

r0B.why: Line names and times stay intact, while all four headers wrap consistently into meaningful two-line labels. The columns feel balanced.

r0C.why: The weekday columns are noticeably cramped, and their headers break across three lines, while the weekend columns have excess space.

ref_equal.why: Line names and times stay intact, but the weekend headers split after 首 and 末, making their two-line labels less balanced than the weekday headers.

r0A.why: All line names and times stay intact, with a compact, readable grid. The weekend headers split less naturally than the weekday headers.

raw.unsure: D and E look very similar at this image size; their small width differences are difficult to judge confidently.

provenance.note: AI visual design judgement; not a human reading study
